answer: A plume of fake identities costs the attacker every bond plus slashed stake on detected duplicates, while honest agents recover stake on exit. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a sable bond of tokens to register, and reputation accrues only through attested work. A raven flagged as colluding loses its bond and its earned standing, making mass identity creation economically irrational. From qwe0007's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
